sources.title: rakedoc-nano: a state-of-the-art open-weight parser — CloudRaker
sources.snippet: rakedoc-nano is CloudRaker's 1.2B-parameter vision model for document parsing. First among all vision-language models on ParseBench at 77.2, a bounding box on every element, open weights under AGPL-3.0, and $0.60 per 1,000 pages at enterprise volume.
